label: Tech support
description: Technical support for computers, devices, printers, software, apps and accounts: errors, setup, performance and access. Not the phone or internet provider's network or plan (that is telecom).

intents.name: device_not_working
intents.description: Hardware does not power on, crashes, overheats or a part fails.
intents.guidance: Ask the model and what changed recently; start with the simplest check (power, cables, restart) before advanced steps.

intents.name: software_error
intents.description: An app or the operating system shows an error, freezes or crashes.
intents.guidance: Ask for the exact error text and when it appears; give one step at a time and check the result before the next.

intents.name: connectivity
intents.description: Wi-Fi, network, Bluetooth or VPN problems on a device.
intents.guidance: Ask whether other devices connect; then restart router and device, forget and rejoin the network, then check drivers or settings.

intents.name: account_access
intents.description: Login problems, forgotten password, locked account or two-factor issues.
intents.guidance: Verify identity per policy before changing anything and use the official reset flow; never ask for the password.

intents.name: performance
intents.description: The device or an app is slow, laggy, or low on storage or memory.
intents.guidance: Ask since when and what is running at the time; check startup apps, free storage and pending updates.

intents.name: setup_install
intents.description: Installing, configuring or updating software or a new device.
intents.guidance: Confirm the device and OS version, then give the next single setup step.

intents.name: general
intents.description: Anything else about this topic that fits no intent above: verification or an unclear line about it (greetings, thanks and goodbyes are general.*).
intents.guidance: Suggest the next useful question that pins down the device and the problem.

facts.description: The main problem in a few words
